import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_product = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors_product)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Top-right: Sales by Customer Age Group
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_group_sales = age_group_sales.reindex([age for age in age_order if age in age_group_sales.index])
colors_age = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_group_sales))
bars = axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(age_group_sales)), age_group_sales.values, color=colors_age)
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(age_group_sales)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(age_group_sales.index, fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                    f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Bottom-left: Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_payment = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[1, 0].pie(payment_counts.values, 
                                           labels=payment_counts.index,
                                           autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                           colors=colors_payment,
                                           startangle=90,
                                           textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(11)
    text.set_fontweight('bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 4. Bottom-right: Average Transaction Value by Size and Takeaway Status
size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().reset_index()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_takeaway['size'] = pd.Categorical(size_takeaway['size'], categories=size_order, ordered=True)
size_takeaway = size_takeaway.sort_values('size')

x_pos = range(len(size_order))
width = 0.35

dine_in = size_takeaway[size_takeaway['is_takeaway'] == 0].set_index('size')['total'].reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
takeaway = size_takeaway[size_takeaway['is_takeaway'] == 1].set_index('size')['total'].reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)

bars1 = axes[1, 1].bar([x - width/2 for x in x_pos], dine_in.values, width, 
                       label='Dine-in', color='#FF7F50', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = axes[1, 1].bar([x + width/2 for x in x_pos], takeaway.values, width,
                       label='Takeaway', color='#6495ED', alpha=0.8)

axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Size and Service Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x_pos)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(size_order, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].legend(fontsize=10, loc='upper left')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        if height > 0:
            axes[1, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                           f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
